stage: On-demand loop target geometry and Tudo timing audit

validation.performance_scope: Single four-physical-core run, passive OpenMP. n3m process CPU and peak RSS include startup, drain and save; exclude FAST_LIO/recording. Blocking controls are separately labelled.

hall_05.scope: Direct prior ROS baseline versus final ROS candidate; unrelated frozen D stream is not assumed equal. PCL padding excluded, every declared field compared.
Direct prior ROS baseline versus final ROS candidate; unrelated frozen D stream is not assumed equal. PCL padding excluded, every declared field compared.

m2_reference.scope: Read-only original ROS1 bag connection inventory and primary publication metadata; no estimator or scorer modification.
findings: Original bags contain no native Xsens output/lever-arm configuration or Leica clock stream from which the missing truth contract can be recovered.
The published calibration separates the Xsens IMU and GNSS antenna; geometric extrinsics alone do not identify which reference point the released position represents.
UBLOX native UTC is a separate receiver and is not a substitute for the Xsens truth clock.
The prior +54 ms effective angular lag and hall planar-course delay remain diagnostics; neither is used to retime position truth or alter the official comparison.
unresolved: Native Xsens and Leica timestamps and export/filter latency

query_weighted.scope: Scalar marker-distance calibration only. All admitted runtime loops retained. GT-gap/near-zero-baseline exclusions affect observer labels only. Same-query edges carry total calibration weight 1; Shared match/query endpoints are grouped explicitly; no independent-sample confidence interval is claimed. No full-SE3 qualification or changed runtime weights; no GT in estimator.

family_holdout.scope: Strict acquisition-family holdout: both TudoRun routes train HelmDyn, and both HelmDyn routes train TudoRun. Signed marker-distance errors require no GT orientation. Shared-query 3D displacement is fitted from off-diagonal residual moments, not repeated independent labels. All runtime observations remain intact. This model also contains shared GT/reference error, assumes equal query/match endpoint scale, and omits cross-query shared matches/temporal correlation; block coverage is descriptive, not independent confidence certification. No production covariance, threshold, pose or timestamp is changed.

robust_family_holdout.scope: Diagnostic only; no production weights, gates, measurements or timestamps changed. Same-query correlations are modeled, repeated labels are not independent trials. Fixed nu=4 robust training limits the influence of grossly inconsistent admitted loops; no observations are removed. Gaussian coverage is descriptive and does not certify a heavy-tailed model. GT/reference errors, shared matches and temporal correlations remain unresolved.

large_residual_audit.scope: Existing admitted loops in both old blocking and final ROS result, not newly introduced by lazy features. Marker-distance labels need no GT orientation. Large residuals cannot be treated as small Gaussian deskew error; graph robustification and other factors keep final poses much closer. No observations removed and no runtime weights changed.

limits: Four MID360 aggregate live RMSE values improve in this measured replay; small saved-trajectory/peak/percentile regressions remain. Not every accuracy metric passes non-regression.
All previous admitted query groups remain, but individual Helm loop edges differ with snapshot timing; not all old observations are retained or proven true.
M2DGR clock/output-reference contract remains unresolved. No favorable timestamp/reference fitting is applied to the estimator or scorer.
No runtime uncertainty weights or admission gates changed. Family-heldout correlation models are not qualified for deployment or full-SE3 calibration.
General 10 cm and heavy-route realtime/half-core remain open; GT gaps and reference uncertainty remain explicit.
Original14 and map-extension routes were not rerun in this stage. Default localization target preparation remains eager.
